name: life-interview-nvda
description: 人生采访局 NVIDIA Agent-Native product and NemoClaw/OpenClaw runtime

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:fast: tsx --test test/diagnostics.test.ts test/auth.test.ts test/ai-task-config.test.ts test/repository-boundary.test.ts test/interview-session.test.ts test/interview-scenarios.test.ts test/interview-closeout.test.ts test/llm-provider.test.ts test/book-repository.test.ts test/onboarding-repository.test.ts test/onboarding-validator.test.ts test/onboarding-years.test.ts test/story-completion.test.ts test/story-generation.test.ts test/story-product-alignment-fixes.test.ts test/story-share.test.ts test/realtime-provider-contract.test.ts src/realtime/qwen.test.ts src/realtime/doubao.test.ts src/realtime/trace.test.ts src/realtime/slow-coordinator.test.ts src/realtime/retriever-recall.test.ts public/audio-format.test.js public/interview-state.test.js public/life-model.test.js public/onboarding-ui.test.js public/result.test.js public/ui-contract.test.js public/book-ui.test.js public/text-disclosure.test.js test/agent-task-contracts.test.ts test/retriever-client.test.ts test/retriever-indexer.test.ts test/era-context/client.test.ts test/era-context/gateway.test.ts test/era-context/server.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: tsx --test test/db.test.ts test/interview-closeout-workflow.test.ts test/onboarding-closeout.test.ts test/onboarding-runtime.test.ts test/realtime-end.test.ts test/realtime-retriever-wiring.test.ts test/server.test.ts test/retriever-server.test.ts test/story-e2e.test.ts test/story-share-api.test.ts test/book-api.test.ts test/book-pdf.test.ts test/book-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:integration && npm run test:agent && npm run test:agent:nat:unit
scripts.test:agent:nat:unit: uv run --project nvidia/nat python -m unittest discover -s nvidia/nat/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:agent:nat:smoke: uv run --project nvidia/nat nat eval --config_file nvidia/nat/configs/smoke.yml
scripts.test:agent:nat:profile: uv run --project nvidia/nat nat eval --config_file nvidia/nat/configs/profiler.yml
scripts.test:agent:nat:eval: uv run --project nvidia/nat nat eval --config_file nvidia/nat/configs/eval.yml
